async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Reports' link with force to bypass any interactability issues
    reports_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Reports')
    await reports_link.click(force=True)
    # Wait for the submenu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Look for the 'Sales' link under the 'Reports' submenu, using .first to avoid multiple matches
    sales_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Sales').first
    await sales_link.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=5000)
    await sales_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
